overview.name: Tuttle Capital Pure Play Photonics ETF
overview.description: Under normal market conditions, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities and swaps referencing companies whose primary business operations are directly related to photonics. The fund is non-diversified.
